sources.title: AI Model Detector — Which AI Made This Image? | PromptShotAI
sources.snippet: Free AI model detector. Upload any image and find out which AI generated it — Midjourney, Flux, SDXL, DALL-E, or Ideogram — with a confidence score and visual tells.

sources.title: AI 3D Model Generator | Image & Text to 3D | Next3D
sources.snippet: Next3D is an AI 3D model generation platform and online 3D file toolkit for image to 3D and text to 3D workflows. Users can generate 3D models from text or images, view GLB, GLTF, OBJ, FBX, STL, and other model files online, and continue through format conversion, preview, and download workflows.
